Name: Ichor's Wobbly Cat
Author: ichortower
Description:
This mod is a celebration of my dear departed cat, published on the anniversary of her death (March 20th).

I hope she can bring you joy!

Now comes with five colors: Tuxedo (the original), Teddy, Calico, Midnight, and Cheeseburger (Cheeseburger provided courtesy of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hylianxprincess/about-me?gameId=1303]hylianxprincess[/url]﻿, included with her blessing).

(The animations are supposed to look a little janky. She was a [url=https://vetmed.tamu.edu/news/pet-talk/wobbly-cat-syndrome/]wobbly cat[/url].)

(I don't recommend giving her a hat, unless you want even more jank. The hat positions are hardcoded to follow the vanilla cat animations; I don't support Hats On Pets Plus at this time.)

[url=https://github.com/ichortower/IchorsCat]Also on GitHub[/url].

[size=5][b][u]How to Use[/u][/b][/size]
This is a Content Patcher pack that adds five additional cat breeds. The new breeds will show up in the character creation menu like the vanilla cats; if you are adding this mod to an established farm, you will either have to wait until you are able to adopt additional pets, or use the console command [font=Courier New][color=#93c47d]debug cmenu[/color][/font] to open the character creation screen and change your initial pet.

Make sure you are using Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.0, and Content Patcher 2.0; this mod won't load in earlier versions.

Downloads.Description: Adds two new colors: Midnight and Cheeseburger. Thanks to hylianxprincess for her Cheeseburger color!
